items.title: Grubhub’s $24M FTC settlement is finally reaching diners and drivers
items.summary: Checks are being mailed from Grubhub's $23.8 million fine from the FTC after it settled allegations over its business practices.

items.title: AI coding startup Cognition reportedly already in talks to raise at $40B valuation
items.summary: Cognition may be looking to raise another mega round just a few months after raising $1 billion at a $26 billion valuation.

items.title: As AI safety concerns mount, three pioneers make the case for staying open
items.summary: At Ai4, three of the world's most respected AI experts—Geoffrey Hinton, Fei-Fei Li, and Andrew Ng—debated regulation, open-source access, and how America can compete as China advances in Asia.

items.title: OpenAI-backed Thrive Holdings raises $2B to bring AI to the enterprise
items.summary: Thrive Holdings has raised $2 billion in new funding at a $12 billion valuation from investors like SoftBank, D1 Capital Partners, and Altimeter Capital.

items.title: Uber Freight reportedly investigating after hacking group claims data breach
items.summary: An extortion gang known for targeting transportation companies and private equity firms has taken credit for a breach at Uber Freight.

items.title: Mesh, Automattic’s CRM for everyone, comes to Android
items.summary: Mesh, an AI-powered contacts app and relationship manager from Automattic, is now an Android app.

items.title: Tesla wants to build a $10B solar factory in Texas
items.summary: Tesla wants to build a massive solar factory in Texas, but first it wants the state to chip in to defray the costs.

items.title: Form Energy raises $750M to build more 100-hour batteries for the grid
items.summary: Form Energy has landed Google and Crusoe as customers. Now, it has raised $750 million to expand manufacturing to deliver its massive, 100-hour batteries.

items.title: Lovable confirms new $13.3B valuation, raises another $400M
items.summary: This new funding comes after Lovable hit $500 million in annualized run rate revenue in June, the startup told TechCrunch.

items.title: Facebook officially rolls out its stand-alone Creator Studio app with AI tools for creators
items.summary: The new app launches with Facebook's AI creator assistant built into it, providing creators with personalized recommendations based on their content style, performance, audience engagement, and goals.

items.title: How a $250 million acquisition collapsed into allegations of fraud and forged signatures
items.summary: Investors are still waiting for their share of the $250 million windfall, and VideoVerse co-founder Vinayak Shrivastav is now at the center of multiple legal cases.

items.title: After Microsoft threatened legal action, a security researcher publishes a new Windows zero-day bug
items.summary: This is the latest zero-day released by security researcher Nightmare Eclipse, despite Microsoft publicly threatening to take legal action against them.

items.title: Silkroad Innovation Hub’s Road to Battlefield competition continues
items.summary: The Road to Battlefield competition is now in its second year, and its purpose is to give founders across Central Eurasia a direct route to Startup Battlefield

items.title: Everything announced at Made by Google ’26: Pixel 11, Pixel Watch 5, Pixel Tag, and tons of Gemini features
items.summary: From the Pixel 11 series and a brand new competitor to Apple’s AirTag, here are all the announcements from the Made by Google 2026 event.

items.title: Google’s Quick Share adds a tap-to-share mode
items.summary: Google's Quick Share feature is getting a tap-to-share mode for quickly exchanging contacts, photos, videos, and more.

items.title: Google’s Pixel 11 lineup offers fewer hardware changes, but much more Gemini
items.summary: The Google Pixel 11 series starts $100 costlier than the last year, but offers 256GB base storage.

items.title: Google unveils the Pixel Watch 5 with a smarter Gemini and advanced health monitoring
items.summary: The new smartwatch, which starts at $399, can track blood pressure patterns and insulin resistance, as well as deliver personalized help and better sleep tracking.

items.title: Google takes on AirTag with the new $29 Pixel Tag
items.summary: Google’s new Pixel Tag taps into its Find Hub network to help users track lost keys, bags, and other items.

items.title: Google’s new Pixel 11 Pro Fold offers a stronger build and brighter screens
items.summary: The Pixel 11 Pro Fold will cost $1,899.
